3900.name: Across a Snow Covered Bridge

north.description: To the north lies Entering the Winterlands.

south.description: To the south lies A Frozen Walkway.

3900.description:
A hump-backed bridge of old grey stone carries the road across a gorge,
its surface smothered in unbroken snow and its low parapets shrunk to
white ridges. Beneath you a frozen stream lies like a pane of dark glass
between the cliffs. Wind hums through the gap and plucks at your cloak.
North the span ends at the edge of the Winterlands, and south it runs on
toward a glazed walkway.

extra_descs.parapet parapets bridge:
The low stone parapets are almost lost under snow, but a few old masons'
marks show where the wind has scoured the stone.

3901.name: Entering the Winterlands

north.description: To the north lies The End of The Winterwood.

south.description: To the south lies Across a Snow Covered Bridge.

3901.description:
The snowfield opens here into a wide bowl of white under a low pewter
sky, with the bridge close behind. Wind-bent pines stand at the rim of
the drifts, their branches clotted with ice. A trampled gap leads north
through the storm-felled timber to where the Winterwood ends, while the
bridge lies to the south. Every breath you take clouds and crackles
before your face.

3902.name: A Frozen Walkway

north.description: To the north lies Across a Snow Covered Bridge.

east.description: To the east lies Lost in the Blizzard.

south.description: To the south lies A Frozen Walkway.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Blizzard.

3902.description:
The walkway is a raised causeway of packed snow glazed with a skin of
clear ice, so slick that each step must be tested. To the east and west
the ground vanishes into whirling white, and a stray step off the edge
would swallow you in the blizzard. Posts of frozen rope, thick with
rime, mark the safe line. The path leads back north toward the bridge
and on south.

3903.name: A Frozen Walkway

north.description: To the north lies A Frozen Walkway.

east.description: To the east lies Lost in the Blizzard.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Blizzard.

3903.description:
The glazed walkway runs on as a pale ribbon through the churning storm,
its surface scored with wind-carved ripples. Snow hisses along it in
thin serpents, and the blizzard presses close to the east and west,
hiding everything beyond the verge. Ahead to the south a great dark
shape looms through the flurries: the Winterland Monument. Back north
the path returns toward the bridge.

3904.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies A Frozen Walkway.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3904.description:
You stand at the foot of the Winterland Monument, a soaring spire of
black stone whose faces are sheathed in ice as thick as your forearm.
Snow has been swept into a tight ring about its plinth, and the walkway
meets it from the north. The trampled path runs east and west around the
base. Runes cut into the plinth are half drowned in frost.

extra_descs.monument spire runes plinth:
The spire is cut from a single block of black stone and rises out of
sight into the grey. Giant-sized runes run around the plinth, too worn
and frosted to read.

3905.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3905.description:
The ring comes to its last corner, where the plinth steps outward in
three broad tiers glazed with ice. Snow lies in the angle of each step
in neat white wedges. East the ring returns toward the walkway, and
south it runs on along the stone. A battered iron brazier, long cold,
sits rusting on the lowest tier.

3906.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3906.description:
On this side of the monument the wind has built a long drift that leans
against the plinth like a frozen wave. The path squeezes between the
drift and the black stone, leading north and south. Blue shadows pool in
the hollows, and your breath hangs in the still air. Scratches in the
ice show where something heavy was dragged along the wall.

3907.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3907.description:
At this corner a heap of fallen masonry, white-capped and frozen into
the drift, spills across the ring. The monument is cracked here, a black
seam the height of its flank filled with glittering ice. The path bends,
leading north around the base and east along it. Silence presses close,
broken only by the creak of settling snow.

3908.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3908.description:
A long straight reach of the ring, where the spire's shadow lies across
the snow like a blade. The ice on the stone is stained blue-green by
some mineral seeping from the joints. Wind funnels along the path from
the east and west alike, tugging at your hood. An iron ring set into the
plinth is crusted solid with frost.

3909.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3909.description:
The ring bends again at the base of the monument, running north and
west. Here the spire's lowest course is carved with a frieze of marching
giants, their stone faces worn blunt by wind and furred with rime. Fine
snow slides off the carving in little sighs. The ground is hard rutted
ice, treacherous under its coat of powder.

3910.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

east.description: To the east lies A Frozen Walkway.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3910.description:
On this flatter stretch of the ring the wind has scoured the snow thin,
leaving dark patches of the old paving bare. A frozen walkway leaves the
ring here and runs east toward a distant gate, while the ring itself
goes north and south. Icicles hang in rows from a ledge of the spire,
tinkling faintly. Your boots ring hollow on the stone.

3911.name: Around the Winterland Monument

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3911.description:
Here the trampled ring turns a corner, curving back west along the
plinth and on toward the south. The spire rises beside you, its black
stone glittering where a thin glaze of ice has formed. A heap of snow
has piled against one corner of the base, packed hard as chalk. The cold
creeps through the seams of your boots like a living thing.

3912.name: A Frozen Walkway

east.description: To the east lies A Frozen Walkway.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3912.description:
The walkway is a narrow shelf of ice between two long banks of drift,
scraped smooth by the wind into a dull blue sheen. Behind you, to the
west, the black spire stands against the sky. Ahead the way runs on
east, and the faint iron smell of a great gate drifts along it. Frost
feathers grow on the rope-posts at the verge, trembling when the gusts
come.

3913.name: A Frozen Walkway

east.description: To the east lies A Frozen Walkway.

west.description: To the west lies A Frozen Walkway.

3913.description:
Halfway along the walkway the drifts rise higher than your shoulders on
both sides, forming a trench of glittering white. Meltwater from some
past thaw has refrozen across the path in a ribbed sheet that must be
crossed with care. The trench runs east toward the gate and west back
toward the monument. Overhead the sky is a flat, pitiless grey.

3914.name: A Frozen Walkway

east.description: To the east lies Before a Massive Portcullis.

west.description: To the west lies A Frozen Walkway.

3914.description:
The drifts fall away and the walkway widens into an apron of ice
scattered with old iron nails and flakes of rust. Ahead to the east a
wall of weathered stone climbs out of the snow, and in it a vast gate
hangs, dark and shut. Frost has furred every rivet of the apron's iron
studs. The path leads back west along the trench of white.

3915.name: Before a Massive Portcullis

west.description: To the west lies A Frozen Walkway.

3915.description:
A massive portcullis of black iron fills an arch cut for creatures far
larger than men, its bars thick as tree trunks and spiked at the foot.
Rime blankets every bar, and long icicles hang from the arch above, some
as tall as you are. Beyond the grating lies only a vast breathing
darkness, and the gate does not stir for any hand. The only way back is
the walkway to the west.

extra_descs.portcullis gate bars:
Each bar of the portcullis is wider than your waist and cold enough to
burn bare skin. The teeth at its foot are sunk deep in a trench of
ancient ice.

3917.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies A Frozen Walkway.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3917.description:
You leave the walkway for a wide shelf of open snow where the wind has
packed the surface into hard ripples. A line of stakes, bleached and
crusted with ice, marks some old boundary and runs off east across the
ground. The glazed walkway lies back north, and the way continues south.
The spire is a dark finger beyond the drifts, and nothing else breaks
the white.

3918.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3918.description:
Frozen furrows run across this stretch of field, the memory of some
long-dead planting, now ridged with ice and hidden under snow. A
blackened fence post leans at an angle, thick with hoarfrost. The track
leads east and west between gently rising drifts. Wind whistles across
the open ground without ever pausing for breath.

3919.name: Around the Winterland Monument

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3919.description:
A shallow bowl in the snow, rimmed with sculpted drifts whose crests
curl like breaking waves. In its floor lies a disc of clear ice through
which you can see the dark ground. The way leads south along the bowl's
edge and west back across the furrows. Your shadow is a pale blue smear
on the white.

3920.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3920.description:
Tall ridges of wind-packed snow flank this stretch, making a corridor
open to the sky. The crust crunches at every step, and the sound carries
a long way in the cold. Old wolf tracks, softened by newer fall, wander
along it from the north toward the south. A ring of smoke-black stones
at one side marks a firepit long gone cold.

3921.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3921.description:
A scatter of boulders sheathed in ice, each wearing a cap of snow,
stands about this corner like sleeping beasts. Beyond them the ground
sinks into a gully choked with drifts. The trail leads north past the
biggest boulder and west across the flats. Cold stings every inch of
exposed skin.

3922.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3922.description:
A half-buried wagon, its wheels rimed and its bed heaped with snow,
rests on its side in the middle of the trail. The wood has gone grey and
brittle with cold, and long icicles hang from the shattered tongue. The
track passes it to the east and west. A snapped axle lies frozen into
the crust.

3923.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3923.description:
A broad flat of old drift, so hard that the wind can find no loose snow
to lift. Pale standing stones, none taller than a child and all sheathed
in ice, form a loose arc around the corner. The path leads north away
from the arc and east along it. The silence here is deep and a little
eerie.

3924.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3924.description:
Skeletal birches, long dead and sheathed in ice, rattle in the wind at
the edge of this field. Between them the snow lies in smooth swells,
unbroken but for the faint stitching of hare prints. The way leads north
toward the walkway and south across a bare flat. Frozen twigs chime
together like tiny bells.

3925.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies A Frozen Walkway.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3925.description:
The walkway gives way to a second plain of snow, flatter and brighter,
where a low sun glares off every surface. Ice spicules cover the ground
like salt, crunching underfoot, and the wind carries a whisper of grit.
The walkway lies back north, while open ground continues east and south.
A single leaning milestone, capped with ice, stands to one side of the
way.

extra_descs.milestone stone:
The milestone is cut with a pattern of notches, a giants' tally of
distance, and one side is furred with white frost.

3926.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3926.description:
Rippling dunes of snow roll across this stretch, sculpted by the wind
into sharp-edged ridges. In the hollows between them the powder is blue
with shadow and wholly untouched. The trail follows the crests east and
west. A frost-split stump, black against the white, is the only upright
thing in sight.

3927.name: Around the Winterland Monument

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3927.description:
The ground slopes into a wide frozen pond, its surface ground milky by
the wind and its edges ruffled with frozen reeds. The trail swings
around the shore, leading south and back west. Cracks run across the ice
with a deep groaning note that carries for miles. Your breath rises in a
ghost and is gone.

3928.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3928.description:
A causeway of hard snow runs between two banks of tall wind-carved
drifts, like a street between white walls. The air within is oddly still
and every sound is deadened. Ice crystals hang glittering in the air,
too fine to fall. The way leads north toward the pond and south along
the walls.

3929.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3929.description:
The great ribcage of some long-dead beast arches out of the drift here,
its bones bleached and crusted with frost. Beneath the arch the trail
bends, running north and west. The snow around it is unmarked and the
cold has a bitter, mineral taste. Far off, a low moan of wind answers
across the plain.

3930.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3930.description:
A stand of ice-furred spruce, stunted and twisted by the wind, crowds
the trail on both sides, their needles stiff as glass. Snow weighs on
every bough, and now and then a branch cracks in the cold like a shot.
Under the trees the ground is a patchwork of ice and powder. The trail
runs east and west through the grove.

3931.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3931.description:
A broad dish of snow, broken by a slab of black rock coated in ice that
thrusts from the drift like a tooth. The trail loops around it, leading
north and east. Faint blue light glows within the ice where the sun
finds it. Your breath freezes into a fine crust on your scarf.

3932.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3932.description:
The field here is pitted with small round hollows where snow has settled
over sinkholes, each rimmed with a delicate collar of frost. The ground
rings dully underfoot. Mountains of cloud stack on the horizon, heavy
with more snow. The path leads north along the edge of the plain and
south toward a tooth of black rock.

3933.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3933.description:
A corner of the field beside what was once the monument's outer wall,
now only a long mound of snow-covered blocks. Icicles as long as spears
hang from an outcrop, and the ice beneath them is pocked where they have
fallen before. The way leads east along the mound and south across the
trampled snow. A thin, steady wind combs the surface into fine lines.

3934.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3934.description:
Snow-waves undulate across this stretch, their tops sharp as knives.
Between them the ground is bare black stone, polished by ice and by
years of wind. The trail runs east and west along a line of cairns whose
stones have frozen into one another. A pale haze of blown crystals
drifts through the air.

3935.name: Around the Winterland Monument

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3935.description:
A wide bend where the plain falls away in a smooth white slope that ends
in a mist of blown crystals. The path turns here, leading south and
west. On the rim of the slope a ring of low black stones stands rimed
with frost, perhaps the foundation of some forgotten hut. The light is
cold and without warmth.

3936.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3936.description:
The long shadow of the monument falls across this stretch, and the snow
is blue-grey and hard. A thin crust of ice splits underfoot with a
series of sharp cracks. The trail leads north and south through the
shadow, where the air is colder still. A bent iron lantern-hook, empty
and furred with rime, juts from a post.

3937.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3937.description:
A drift has swallowed half of a stone horse-trough, leaving only a rim
of frozen stone above the white. The trough is filled with solid ice and
scarred by a hundred small scratches. The way leads north along the
shade and west across the open field. Somewhere a loose sheet of ice
flaps and clatters in the wind.

3938.name: Around the Winterland Monument

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

west.description: To the west lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3938.description:
A signpost of grey timber leans in the snow, its arms glazed over so
that no word can be read on them. The ground is a stiff white crust that
squeaks like leather. East and west the track runs, flanked by wind-
gouged troughs where the drifts stand in pale ranks. The sky overhead
has the colour of old pewter.

3939.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

east.description: To the east lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3939.description:
Footprints crowd this corner, old and new, frozen into the crust in a
confusing tangle. The snow is stained brownish where something was
dragged away. The track leads north along the edge of the field and east
across the open ground. Fresh flakes drift in on the wind and slowly
soften every mark.

3940.name: Around the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3940.description:
A pair of snow-buried pillars, carved with spirals, flank the track and
glitter with frost. Sleet has crusted the ground into a dark glaze that
shows your reflection, bent and pale. The way leads north and south
along the pillars. The air carries the faint, stony chill of a great
hollow place close by.

3941.name: A Crudely Formed Staircase

west.description: To the west lies Entrance to the Winterland Monument.

down.description: To the down lies A Crudely Formed Staircase.

3941.description:
The chamber narrows into the head of a crudely cut stair, hewn by huge
impatient tools. The steps are uneven, some as high as your knee, and
each wears a glaze of ice. The way back west returns to the monument's
base, and the stair plunges down into darkness. Cold air breathes along
it, smelling of stone and old frost.

3942.name: The Bottom of a Crude Staircase

east.description: To the east lies A Cavern Entrance.

up.description: To the up lies A Crudely Formed Staircase.

3942.description:
The crude stair ends on a floor of trampled rock slick with ice.
Overhead the roof is lost in blackness, and the walls glitter with
frozen seepage. To the east the passage opens into a vaster space whose
echoes drift back to you. The stair rises behind you toward the surface.

3943.name: A Cavern Entrance

north.description: To the north lies North West Corner of a Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies Center of a Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies South West Corner of a Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies The Bottom of a Crude Staircase.

3943.description:
A wide mouth of rock opens into a cavern of immense size, where the air
is as still as held breath. Pillars of ice stand in rows, taller than
houses, glowing with a deep blue light of their own. Passages of frozen
floor lead north, east and south, and the stair lies back west. Every
sound is swallowed and then returned a moment late.

3944.name: North West Corner of a Cavern

east.description: To the east lies Northern End of a Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Cavern Entrance.

3944.description:
Here the cavern wall meets the roof in a tight corner thick with
icicles, some as long as spears, dripping slowly onto a frozen puddle.
The rock is slick and glassy, scored in places by huge claw-like
grooves. The cavern opens east along the wall and south toward its
entrance. A faint draught carries the smell of cold iron.

3945.name: Center of a Cavern

north.description: To the north lies Northern End of a Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies Eastern End of a Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies Southern End of a Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Cavern Entrance.

3945.description:
At the heart of the cavern a great ring of ice pillars stands around a
floor of blue-white frost, polished by long years of cold. The roof is
lost far overhead, and a deep slow dripping measures the silence. Paths
of trampled ice lead away in every direction, north, south, east and
west. The pillars catch what little light there is and throw it back in
cold shards.

3946.name: South West Corner of a Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Cavern Entrance.

east.description: To the east lies Southern End of a Cavern.

3946.description:
A corner of rough, unworked rock where the frost has grown thick and
furred, as though the cave had grown a pelt. The floor is gritty with
frozen sand and slick underneath. The cavern leads north toward its
entrance and east along the cavern wall. A wet, bitter smell hangs in
the air.

3947.name: Northern End of a Cavern

east.description: To the east lies North East Corner of a Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies Center of a Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies North West Corner of a Cavern.

3947.description:
The floor of this stretch is a sheet of ice so clear that you can see
pale rock in its depths. A line of low frozen pools runs along the wall,
each ringed by a collar of white crystals. The cavern continues west
toward a corner, east toward another, and south toward its middle. Water
ticks down from the roof in the silence.

3948.name: Southern End of a Cavern

north.description: To the north lies Center of a Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies South East Corner of a Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies South West Corner of a Cavern.

3948.description:
The floor here is littered with shards of ice that have fallen from the
roof and shattered, glittering in drifts against the walls. A single
tall column of frost stands near the wall, its heart clouded white. The
cavern runs on east and west along its edge, and a wider space opens
north. Cold seeps through every layer of clothing.

3949.name: North East Corner of a Cavern

south.description: To the south lies Eastern End of a Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies Northern End of a Cavern.

3949.description:
In this corner the roof sweeps low, hung with curtains of ice that
ripple like frozen cloth. Where they meet the floor they have fused into
smooth, glistening columns. The only ways out lead south along the
cavern's edge and west along the wall. Hoarfrost lies on the stone as
thick as fur.

3950.name: Eastern End of a Cavern

north.description: To the north lies North East Corner of a Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Massive Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies South East Corner of a Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies Center of a Cavern.

3950.description:
The eastern end of the cavern is sealed by a wall of dark carved stone
in which a massive door of black timber stands, banded with iron and
furred with frost. Giant footprints of long-melted ice are worn into the
floor before it, deeper than a man's boot. The door leads east into the
hallway beyond. The cavern opens north, south and west behind you.

3951.name: South East Corner of a Cavern

north.description: To the north lies Eastern End of a Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies Southern End of a Cavern.

3951.description:
A low corner of the cavern where the floor slopes toward a shallow bowl
of black ice. Frozen runnels trace the walls like the veins of a leaf.
The chamber leads north toward the great door and west along the cavern
wall. The air tastes of metal and your breath comes out in slow white
plumes.

3952.name: A Massive Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Massive Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Eastern End of a Cavern.

3952.description:
You stand in a hallway of colossal size, its walls of fitted black stone
rising far beyond the reach of any light. Great pillars of ice have been
left standing along its length, and the floor is worn into shallow
channels by generations of enormous feet. The great door stands west,
and the hall runs on east. Every breath you take echoes like a whisper
in a vast tomb.

3953.name: A Massive Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Massive Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Massive Hallway.

3953.description:
Banners of frozen cloth hang stiff from iron poles along the hall,
painted with giant sigils that have flaked away under the ice. A long
trough of black stone runs along the wall, filled with solid blue ice.
The hallway continues east and west, and your steps ring out as though
it were a bell. The cold here is dry and vast.

extra_descs.banners sigils:
The banners have frozen into stiff folds like sheets of tin. The sigils
on them show a crowned head over crossed axes, though most of the paint
has gone.

3954.name: A Massive Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Massive Hallway.

3954.description:
The hall narrows toward another door, as massive as the first, its
panels carved with scenes of giants hunting in the snow. A throne-sized
bench of ice sits against the wall, its arms worn smooth by use. The
door lies east, and the hall continues back west. Drifts of fine snow
have blown in under the door and lie in a pale crescent.

3955.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Massive Hallway.

3955.description:
You stand just inside a vast cavern, where the great door lies back west
and the floor of dark rock stretches away in a frozen plain. Stalactites
of ice hang from the roof in clusters, pale as bone, and the air hums
with a thin high note as the draught passes through them. Passages open
north, east and south across the glittering floor. Your lamplight, if
you have any, goes a very short way.

3956.name: A Large Cavern

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

3956.description:
The floor here is a single sheet of ice, cracked in a pattern like a
spider's web, with a gleam of black water far beneath. Along the rock
wall huge sconces of iron stand empty, each as wide as a barrel and
frozen to the stone. The cavern leads east across the cracked sheet and
south back toward the door hall. The ice groans softly when you move.

3957.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3957.description:
The cavern roof soars here into a dome so high that its crown is lost in
mist, and frozen chandeliers of ice hang from a hundred points. Long
drifts of snow have blown through unseen cracks and piled against the
walls. Ways lead north, east, south and west across the polished floor.
Your voice returns to you from every side, thinned and strange.

3958.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

3958.description:
A cramped corner at the edge of the cavern, where the frost lies thick
on the walls and the floor is a hard crust of old snow. A cairn of fist-
sized stones, coated in ice, stands at the foot of the wall as though
left as a marker. Passages lead north toward the door and east along the
wall. The cold here is dry and keen.

3960.name: A Large Cavern

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

3960.description:
A narrow corner of the cavern, where the roof comes lower and dozens of
icicles hang within reach of your hand. The rock floor is dry and
gritty, strangely free of frost, and warmer than the rest. A gnawed
length of bone as thick as your arm lies wedged into a crack in the
wall. The cavern opens east and south from this nook.

3961.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3961.description:
Thick columns of blue ice rise from floor to roof in a tangle, so wide
that three men could not circle one. Their surfaces are marbled with
trapped bubbles and streaks of grit. You pick a path between them, with
openings leading north, east, south and west. Light flickers deep within
the ice like a distant fire.

3962.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3962.description:
Wide steps of natural rock lead across this part of the cavern, each
wearing a thin glaze of ice that must be crossed with care. The air is
bitter and smells of wet stone, and a faint echo of dripping rises from
somewhere ahead. Passages open north, east, south and west. A line of
old bootprints, huge and frozen, crosses the steps.

3963.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

3963.description:
A dead-end niche with a floor of coarse gravel and a roof stained rust-
red by mineral water, frozen in streaks like dried blood. A single
column of ice stands in the middle, with a hollow at its heart where the
cold glows. Paths lead north and east from the niche. The stone is slick
and every sound seems to hang in the air.

3965.name: A Large Cavern

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3965.description:
A gentle slope of rubble, frozen into a single mass, spreads across the
cavern floor toward a ridge of fallen stone. Each rock wears a crown of
hoarfrost, and the smaller ones are cemented in place by ice. The way
leads east beyond the ridge, south across the slope, and west toward the
nook. A trickle of meltwater ticks somewhere out of sight.

3966.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3966.description:
The roof here is hung with a forest of slender icicles, a thousand of
them, each tipped with a bead of frozen light. When you breathe, they
sing faintly, a shimmering chord that rises and falls. The floor is
rimed in feathery crystals. You can go north, east, south or west from
this glittering grove.

3967.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3967.description:
A broad, level floor of old black ice, laid out like a vast hall, the
sort of place where giants might hold their gatherings. Rows of low
benches cut from the rock itself run along either side, cushioned with
deep drifts of frost. Openings in the stone lead north, east, south and
west. A thin white mist crawls along the ground.

3968.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3968.description:
A hollow in the floor holds a frozen lake the size of a village green,
black as slate and veined with white cracks. Mounds of rubble ring the
edge, and a trail of scuffed frost runs around the hollow. The passage
continues north and south around its rim, with openings east and west.
Something cold and old seems to sleep beneath the ice.

3969.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3969.description:
A low, tight stretch where the roof presses close and the walls are
black with soot beneath their frost. Charred stumps of ancient torches
still jut from sockets in the rock. The passage runs east and west, with
a wider space opening north. The ice underfoot is dingy and gritty,
mixed with ash.

3970.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3970.description:
The end of a rough tunnel, walled with glittering rock and floored with
powdery frost that billows when you walk. Bits of broken ice-armour,
dented and green with age, lie fused into the wall, the remains of some
long-ago battle. The only exits are north and back west. It is very
quiet and the cold leans on your shoulders.

3971.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3971.description:
A crossing of four wide passages, the floor worn smooth by a procession
of huge boots over centuries. In the middle of the crossing a block of
ice stands as tall as a man, rough-hewn into the shape of a seated
figure, its features eroded to a smooth blur. Ways lead north, east,
south and west from its feet. The air smells of old smoke and cold
stone.

extra_descs.figure block ice seated:
The seated figure is rough work, but it has a crown on its brow and its
hands rest on its knees, as a king might sit.

3972.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3972.description:
Rubble from a fallen section of roof litters the floor here, thrown into
heaps of frost-welded boulders. Through the hole it left, a shaft of
pale glow falls from some higher crack and glitters on the ice. The
cavern leads north, east, south and west between the heaps. Dust of
frozen stone crunches beneath your feet.

3973.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3973.description:
A ring of broken pillars stands here, their stumps capped with ice, as
though some giants' hall once stood in the cavern and was cast down.
Fragments of carved stone lie half-buried in the frost, patterned with
spirals and knotwork. Paths of trampled ice lead north, east, south and
west among the ruins. The air feels thick and watchful.

3974.name: A Large Cavern

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3974.description:
At this corner the cavern wall is a curved sweep of rock glazed with ice
so smooth it mirrors your torch. Long scratches, deeper than a hand is
wide, run across it at a height well above your head. Frozen puddles
pave the floor in a mosaic of white plates. The only ways onward are
south and back west.

3976.name: A Large Cavern

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3976.description:
Here the cavern wall bulges inward, forming a recess where the frost has
grown into delicate ferns and feathers on the rock. The floor is slick
with a fine skin of ice that seems to flow when the lamplight moves.
Passages lead south toward a heavy door's glow and west along the wall.
Silence lies thick, broken by a distant crack of settling ice.

3977.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies The Creator's Workshop.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3977.description:
A wide, flat floor of packed stone before a doorway cut into the cavern
wall, with a lintel of iron beams that shows scorch marks beneath the
rime. The ground is trampled to bare rock by countless heavy feet, and
ash lies grey in the corners. The door in the wall leads east into the
workshop beyond. Other ways run north, south and west across the cavern
floor.

3978.name: A Large Cavern

north.description: To the north lies A Large Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3978.description:
The cavern floor tilts here toward a pit of black ice, round and smooth
as a bowl, its edges rimmed with frozen spray. The walls are daubed with
old crude paintings in soot, pictures of hunters with enormous spears
chasing something with antlers. A path leads north toward the forge door
and west across the slope. Your steps crackle and echo.

3980.name: A Crudely Formed Staircase

up.description: To the up lies A Crudely Formed Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies A Crudely Formed Staircase.

3980.description:
The stair twists here in a steep spiral through raw rock, the walls
still scarred with the marks of picks and hammers. Ice has crept from
the seams to form beards of white that brush your shoulders. A faint
blue glimmer comes from somewhere beneath. The steps lead on down and
back up toward the monument.

3981.name: A Crudely Formed Staircase

up.description: To the up lies A Crudely Formed Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies The Bottom of a Crude Staircase.

3981.description:
Here the stair is wider, as though the diggers grew tired of cutting
small steps, and its treads are as deep as a man is tall. A scatter of
frozen rubble lies in the corners where the giants left it. The cold
deepens with every step, and your footfalls ring and return. The way
leads up toward the surface and down toward the sound of dripping.

3989.name: Lost in the Blizzard

north.description: To the north lies Lost in the Blizzard.

east.description: To the east lies Lost in the Blizzard.

south.description: To the south lies Lost in the Blizzard.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Blizzard.

up.description: To the up lies A Frozen Walkway.

3989.description:
Snow screams past in a solid curtain, and the world shrinks to the
length of your own arm. Sky, ground and horizon are one bruised white,
and whichever way you turn, north, south, east or west, looks exactly
like the last. Ice crusts your lashes and your cloak stiffens like a
board. The glazed walkway must lie close by, if only you could find it
again.

3998.name: Entrance to the Winterland Monument

north.description: To the north lies Around the Winterland Monument.

east.description: To the east lies A Crudely Formed Staircase.

south.description: To the south lies Around the Winterland Monument.

3998.description:
You stand in the base of the monument, a low square chamber of black
stone where the howl of the wind is muffled to a moan. Ice sheathes the
walls, and grey light seeps through the arches that open north and south
onto the snowfield. To the east, frost-rimed steps lead into a crude
stair. Carvings of giant hands are cut deep into the lintel, fingers
spread as if to bar the way.

extra_descs.lintel carvings hands:
The hands carved in the lintel are each larger than a man, their palms
outward and their fingers spread in warning.

3999.name: The Creator's Workshop

west.description: To the west lies A Large Cavern.

3999.description:
A vast forge-hall hacked from the living rock, where a hearth wide as a
cottage glows with dull red embers at the far wall. Anvils the size of
wagons stand about the floor, and racks of huge tongs, hammers and
chisels line the walls, rimed with frost. Half-finished figures of ice
and iron loom in the shadows, their blank faces turned toward the fire.
The only way out is the door leading back west.

extra_descs.anvils anvil hearth:
The anvils are black iron, their faces dented by blows no mortal arm
could deliver. The hearth still holds embers that give off no flame,
only a dull red glow.

652200.name: frost wolf white
652200.long_desc: A gaunt frost wolf prowls the snow here, rime clinging to its pale fur.
652200.description:
Its coat is white as the drifts and its eyes burn a pale blue. Ice hangs
from its jaws, and its ribs show through the thick fur.

652201.name: white cave bear
652201.long_desc: A huge white cave bear shambles across the frozen floor, snuffling at the ice.
652201.description:
The bear is vast and shaggy, its white fur matted with frost and its
claws thick as horn. It sways its head from side to side, watching you
with small black eyes.

652202.name: rime spider icy
652202.long_desc: A pale rime spider clings to the ice, its long legs dusted with frost.
652202.description:
The spider is the size of a dog, its body translucent as ice and its
legs tipped with crystal. Threads of frozen silk trail behind it and
glitter in the dark.

652203.name: ice troll
652203.long_desc: A hulking ice troll stomps through the snow, its grey hide caked with frost.
652203.description:
The troll is stooped and enormous, with a hide like cracked slate and
long arms that drag in the snow. Icicles hang from its chin and its
breath rolls out in great grey clouds.

652204.name: frost ghost wraith pale
652204.long_desc: A frost-wreathed ghost drifts through the cold, trailing a mist of ice crystals.
652204.description:
The ghost is the pale shape of a long-dead hunter, rimed in white and
fading at the edges. Its eyes are hollow wells of blue light and the
cold around it bites to the bone.

652205.name: frost giant warrior
652205.long_desc: A frost giant warrior stands guard here, his huge axe resting on one shoulder.
652205.description:
He is three times the height of a man, with skin of blue-white and a
beard braided with beads of ice. A huge frost-rimed axe is in his fist,
and his eyes are pitiless.

652206.name: skarn rimeforger giant smith
652206.long_desc: Skarn the Rimeforger, a soot-blackened frost giant, hammers at a glowing anvil.
652206.description:
Skarn is a giant of the old line, his blue skin scarred with burns and
his leather apron stiff with soot and frost. His arms are as thick as
pine trunks, and he swings a hammer the size of a barrel.

652207.name: hrimgar frost giant king
652207.long_desc: Hrimgar, the Frost Giant King, sits his icy throne, a crown of black iron on his brow.
652207.description:
Hrimgar is taller than the hall's own pillars, his skin the blue of deep
glacier ice and his beard falling to his knees in frozen braids. A crown
of black iron sits on his brow, and his gaze alone makes your breath
freeze in your throat.

752200.name: white wolf pelt cloak
752200.room_desc: A white wolf-pelt cloak lies here, stiff with frost.
752200.description: A cloak cut from a thick white wolf pelt, heavy and warm. It still smells faintly of snow and wild beast.

752201.name: rime silk gloves pale
752201.room_desc: A pair of pale rime-silk gloves lies here.
752201.description: Gloves woven from the frozen silk of cave spiders, fine as cobweb and surprisingly strong. They never quite lose their chill.

752202.name: frozen tear gem blue
752202.room_desc: A glittering blue tear of ice lies here.
752202.description: A teardrop-shaped gem of clear blue ice that never melts, however warm the hand that holds it. Collectors pay well for such things.

752203.name: rimeforged maul hammer
752203.room_desc: A heavy rimeforged maul lies here, rimed white.
752203.description: A maul of blue-black iron, its head patterned with frost and its haft bound in wolf hide. It is made for a giant's grip, but a strong man can swing it.

752204.name: crown frost king iron
752204.short_desc: the crown of the Frost Giant King
752204.room_desc: A black iron crown rimmed with frost lies here.
752204.description: A crown of black iron, set with chips of blue ice that glow faintly in the dark. Cut down for mortal brows, it still weighs heavily and fills the wearer with a stubborn, bitter cold courage.
